learning_outcomes.text: Learn basic concepts of technical drawing subjects related to engineering, such as: geometry (plane and descriptive), representation systems, interpretation of plans using standardization, and computer drawing.
Develop reasoning attitudes, using and combining the above concepts, to solve geometric and engineering problems.
Acquire proficiency in freehand sketching, scaled drawing with set square, protractor, and compass; and computer drawing in both two and three dimensions with widely used CAD software in engineering.
Learn the graphic language that will allow, in subsequent subjects, to learn how to carry out engineering designs, generating the relevant plans and/or 3D virtual models.

teaching_methods: Problem-based learning: Develop active learning through problem-solving that fosters student thinking and/or experimentation, as well as decision-making.
Expository/Lectures: Transmit knowledge and activate cognitive processes in the student, involving their participation.
Exercise and problem solving: Practice, rehearse, and apply prior knowledge through routine repetition.
assessment_rules: The final grade requires obtaining at least 3 out of 10 points in the global qualification of each exam block. In the extraordinary call, pending blocks can be recovered. For the special October call and the graduation call, evaluation will be a single 100% full exam. Exams are conducted manually (paper, pencil, drawing tools) and using a computer with Autocad software. Correction criteria include correctness, application of UNE and DIN standards, clarity, and proportion.
